audit.whatIsWrong: The lane was written as if Shield Vault could be dodged: 'punish any missed stun', 'Punish Shield Vault misses with a full combo', 'punishing a missed Shield Vault becomes a near-guaranteed kill'.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 'Pantheon dashes to a target, damaging and stunning them' — targeted, 600 range, 13/12/11/10/9, with an auto-attack reset attached. There is no miss state. A player told to wait for the whiff waits forever and dies to a stun that was always going to land.
audit.corrected: The lane is now framed as spacing plus cooldown counting: stay outside 600, and the punish window is the 13 seconds after he spends it, not a whiff that never comes.

audit.whatIsWrong: The ultimate was named 'Grand Skyfall' in whys[4], spikes[1].text, content mid and wants.you[2], and wants.foe[2] said 'Land Grand Skyfall'.
audit.why: The real name is Grand Starfall — 180/165/150 on a 5500 range. The packet flagged this as a probable wrong name and it is confirmed against the kit. Same class of error as 'Ares of Blaze' for Brand's R.
audit.corrected: Grand Starfall everywhere, with the 5500 range and the 180s rank-1 cooldown supplied so the advice is concrete: ward wide, choose your ground before he lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault appeared nowhere on the page — not once, in any field. It is the ability that decides how you poke him.
audit.why: 'Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear' — 22/21/20/19/18, 400 range, and it carries the shield, untargetable and channel flags. Damage is blocked from the FRONT only, which means your 900-range Q into his face is the one angle that does nothing while it is up.
audit.corrected: Written into winCon, breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[0].d, whys[5], spikes[2].text and content late: the block is directional, so poke the flank or wait out the 22s.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit — defect-catalogue item 3 — and dosFull[2].d invented a number, calling the Shield Vault window a 'fifteen-second invitation'.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9. Fifteen seconds is not a rank of it at any level, so the reader is being told to commit into a stun that is already back.
audit.corrected: Real numbers throughout: W 13s at rank 1 down to 9s at rank 5, E 22s, Q 11s, R 180/165/150, your W 22s and E 15s. The invented fifteen-second figure is gone.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string pasted under 'Keep one of W/E banked at all times', and dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string pasted under 'Fight outside the zone post-6 if it's down'. dontsFull[0].d also referred to a single male enemy as 'they'.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to answer their own titles, using the two exits' real cooldowns against his 13s stun; the 'they' line replaced with the Aegis Assault interaction.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two of the three flagged missing interactions are now written in (the directional block, and the auto-reset as the burst tell). The third — that Between Worlds cancels the Aegis Assault channel — is NOT written in, deliberately.
audit.why: The missing-interactions file asserts the cancel on the strength of Aurora's R carrying a hardCC flag. Riot's own description of Between Worlds says only that the shockwave 'damages and slows'. The brief's rule is explicit: when a derived flag contradicts the description, trust the description. So I cannot claim the R interrupts a channel, and I will not.
audit.corrected: Nothing asserted. Recorded in unverified and questionsForUser.

audit.whatIsWrong: LEVEL CHART DISAGREEMENT, LEFT ALONE DELIBERATELY. phases[0..6].side all read 'Pantheon' while content win[0..6] all read 'Aurora'. On top of that, whys[0] and whys[1] describe Pantheon ahead early — agreeing with phases[].side and contradicting win[].
audit.why: I cannot resolve it. packet.levelChart says Aurora x7 and win[] agrees, but the win rate is 49.89% over 888 games and the page's own diff is HARD at 8/10 with a carry threat of 8.5 — you do not rate a matchup 8/10 hard and then win all seven stages of it. The kit cuts the other way for the early rows too: a targeted 600-range stun with an auto reset against a squishy 900-range mage is a level 1-3 Pantheon favours, and I am not willing to write 'Aurora wins level 1' into a page on a coin-flip matchup to make a chart tidy.
audit.corrected: No side, no rating, no win[] and no whys[0]/whys[1] edit. Recorded in questionsForUser.

notes: PACKET DEFECT CONFIRMED AND FIXED: 'Grand Skyfall' is not an ability. The real name is Grand Starfall (R, 180/165/150, 5500 range) and the wrong name appeared in four places. The packet's second suspect, 'Use Comet Spear', is a FALSE POSITIVE — Comet Spear is Pantheon's real Q name per the kit, so wants.foe[1] was left exactly as it stands. A WHIFF THAT CANNOT HAPPEN: four fields told the reader to punish a 'missed' Shield Vault. It is 'Pantheon dashes to a target, damaging and stunning them' — targeted, 600 range, with an auto-attack reset. It has no miss state, and a player waiting for one waits until he dies. Rewritten as spacing plus the 13s cooldown. AN INVENTED NUMBER REMOVED: dosFull[2].d called the post-vault window a 'fifteen-second invitation'. Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9 — fifteen seconds is not a rank of it at any level, so the advice sent the reader in against a stun that was already back. AEGIS ASSAULT WAS ENTIRELY ABSENT from the page — not one field mentioned it. It is a 22s channel that makes him invulnerable to damage from the FRONT, which is the single most important fact about poking Pantheon, and it is now in six fields. CHART LEFT ALONE ON PURPOSE: phases[0..6].side all read 'Pantheon', content win[0..6] all read 'Aurora', and whys[0]/whys[1] side with the full layer against win[]. packet.levelChart says Aurora x7, but the win rate is 49.89% and the page rates the matchup HARD at 8/10 with an 8.5 carry threat — those cannot all be true at once. I changed no side, no rating, no win[] row, and deliberately left whys[0] and whys[1] alone rather than pick a side by writing prose. It needs a human decision; see questionsForUser. DO NOT MISREAD THE UNTOUCHED whys[0]/whys[1] AS AGREEMENT — they are held pending that decision.
unverified: Whether Between Worlds interrupts the Aegis Assault channel. The missing-interactions file asserts it does, on the strength of the R's hardCC flag, but Riot's description of Between Worlds says only that the shockwave 'damages and slows' — no immobilise. Per the brief's rule I trusted the description and wrote nothing about a cancel. If the hardCC flag is correct this is a major unwritten interaction; if it is a tooltip-parsing misfire it affects every Aurora matchup in the lane.

Comet Spear's effective range. The kit lists 575, but Riot's text ('either thrusts his spear or throws his spear') describes two modes and only one number is given. I avoided stating any Q range anywhere rather than tell the reader 575 is safe when the thrown mode may reach further.
